verdict.rationale: Ollama documents plain API keys for calling its cloud models. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or issued per agent with least privilege, so a basic API key is only an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Call cloud models with an API key. No Ollama installation required.
